name: SDS
recent: SDS 近期持续进行股份回购，并在2026年8月28日召开特别股东大会通过以1.017亿令吉收购柔佛新山永久地契土地的议案，该交易随后成为无条件。此外，董事 Tan Kim Seng 和 Tan Kim Chai 在11月10日有股份交易，涉及SDS Tan Properties的股权转让。
notable: SDS 的独资子公司 London Bakery 以1.017亿令吉收购柔佛新山永久地契土地，交易已于2026年8月28日成为无条件。
公司近期多次进行股份回购，最近一次在2026年11月25日。
董事 Tan Kim Seng 和 Tan Kim Chai 于2026年11月10日进行股份交易，涉及SDS Tan Properties的股权转让。
risks: 董事 Tan Kim Seng 和 Tan Kim Chai 在2026年11月10日有股份处置交易。
公司近期持续进行股份回购，可能影响股本结构。

recent_en: SDS has been continuously conducting share buybacks recently. On 28 August 2026, an EGM approved the acquisition of a freehold land in Johor Bahru for RM101.7 million, which subsequently became unconditional. In addition, directors Tan Kim Seng and Tan Kim Chai had share dealings on 10 November involving a transfer of shares in SDS Tan Properties.
notable_en: SDS's wholly-owned subsidiary London Bakery acquired a freehold land in Johor Bahru for RM101.7 million, and the deal became unconditional on 28 August 2026.
The company has conducted multiple share buybacks recently, with the latest on 25 November 2026.
Directors Tan Kim Seng and Tan Kim Chai had share dealings on 10 November 2026 involving a transfer of shares in SDS Tan Properties.
risks_en: Directors Tan Kim Seng and Tan Kim Chai had share disposal transactions on 10 November 2026.
The company has been continuously conducting share buybacks recently, which may affect its share capital structure.
